% Bài làm buổi 20/10 — Tôm
\begin{problem}[8DS-PT1-001]
a) $4x - 20 = 0$
$4x = 20$
$x = 5$
b) $5x + 8 = 3x - 4$
$5x - 3x = -4 + 8$
$2x = 4$
$x = 2$
Đáp số: a) $x = 5$; b) $x = 2$
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}[8DS-PT1-003]
$3(x - 2) - 2(x + 1) = 5 - x$
$3x - 6 - 2x - 2 = 5 - x$
$x - 8 = 5 - x$
$x + x = 5 + 8$
$2x = 13$
$x = \dfrac{13}{2}$
Vậy phương trình có nghiệm $x = \dfrac{13}{2}$.
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}[8DS-HDT-001]
a) $(x + 3)^2 = x^2 + 2 \cdot x \cdot 3 + 3^2 = x^2 + 6x + 9$
b) $(2x - y)^2 = 2x^2 - 2 \cdot 2x \cdot y + y^2 = 2x^2 - 4xy + y^2$
c) $(x - 4)(x + 4) = x^2 - 4^2 = x^2 - 16$
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}[8DS-PTNT-001]
a) $4x^2y - 6xy^2 = 2xy \cdot 2x - 2xy \cdot 3y = 2xy(2x - 3y)$
b) $5x(x - 2) - 4(x - 2) = (x - 2)(5x - 4)$
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}[8DS-PT1-005]
$(x + 2)^2 - (x - 3)(x + 3) = 5x + 1$
$x^2 + 4x + 4 - (x^2 - 9) = 5x + 1$
$x^2 + 4x + 4 - x^2 + 9 = 5x + 1$
$4x + 13 = 5x + 1$
$4x - 5x = 1 - 13$
$-x = -12$
$x = 12$
\end{problem}
